Attach extra questionnaire variables to the child table

Source: R/config_kc9.R
attach_child_variables.Rd

map_vcs_variables() only carries the concepts in the dictionary. This pulls any {c}_{k}-indexed variables from the raw export onto x$children, matched by interview and repeat indices, so that behavioural and child-health questions can be tabulated with the survey design.

attach_child_variables(
  x,
  variables,
  raw = NULL,
  naming = c("caregiver_child", "roster")
)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object whose raw is still attached (or pass raw).

variables

Variable stems, e.g. c("BESD01", "ORS01").

raw

The raw export, if x$raw was dropped.

naming

"caregiver_child" for the <var>_{c}_{k} columns of the child module, or "roster" for the rost_<var>_{k} columns built in roster mode.

Value

x, with the variables added to x$children.

See also
